title: Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) for High-Frequency Limit Order Book Forecasting: Efficiency, Interpretability, and Alpha Decay
abstract: arXiv:2601.02310v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: High-Frequency trading (HFT) environments are characterised by large volumes of limit order book (LOB) data, which is notoriously noisy and non-linear. Alpha decay represents a significant challenge, with traditional models such as DeepLOB losing predictive power as the time horizon (k) increases. In this paper, using data from the FI-2010 dataset, we introduce Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) to replace the fixed, linear weights of standard LSTMs with learnable B-spline activation functions. This allows the model to learn the 'shape' of market signals as opposed to just their magnitude. This resulted in a 19.1% relative improvement in the F1-score at the k = 100 horizon. The efficacy of T-KAN networks cannot be understated, producing a 132.48% return compared to the -82.76% DeepLOB drawdown under 1.0 bps transaction costs. translated_title: 用于高频限价订单簿预测的时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN）：效率、可解释性与阿尔法衰减
translated_abstract: 高频交易（HFT）环境的特点是存在海量的限价订单簿（LOB）数据，这些数据以噪声大和非线性著称。阿尔法衰减是一个重大挑战，传统模型如DeepLOB随着预测时间范围（k）的增加而逐渐失去预测能力。本文基于FI-2010数据集的数据，引入时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），用可学习的B样条激活函数取代标准LSTM中固定的线性权重。这使得模型能够学习市场信号的“形状”，而不仅仅是其幅度。该方法在k = 100时间范围内使F1分数相对提升了19.1%。T-KAN网络的有效性不容小觑，在1.0个基点交易成本下产生了132.48%的回报，而DeepLOB的回撤为-82.76%。此外，T-KAN模型被证明具有良好的可解释性，“死区”清晰可见。
tldr: 本文提出时序Kolmogorov-Arnold网络（T-KAN），用可学习的B样条激活函数替代LSTM的固定线性权重来预测限价订单簿，在k=100时间范围内F1分数相对提升19.1%，实现132.48%的回报并显著缓解阿尔法衰减问题，同时具备良好的可解释性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Temporal Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (T-KAN) that replace fixed linear LSTM weights with learnable B-spline activation functions for limit order book forecasting, achieving a 19.1% relative F1-score improvement at the k=100 horizon, a 132.48% return, enhanced interpretability, and effective mitigation of alpha decay.
